Exam Date & Time: 12-May-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech VI Semester  
  End Semester Examination - April / May -2025  
  Cloud Computing [CSE-4063]  
Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
1)           Construct the concept of cloud delivery utilization model or service models and explain  
  with neat block diagrams.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)       List and explain the pre-existing technologies considered to be the primary influences on  
  cloud computing.                                                                          (3)  
  
  C)       Analyse working of desktop virtualization.                                                  (2)  
2)            List and conclude the data center elements that can be integrated in a hyperconverged  
  infrastructure.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)       Choose the technical support to design the hyperconverged data centre.                      (3)  
  C)       Discover and Define bucket and identify the purpose of bucket.                              (2)  
3)            Web Services Resource Framework is referred to as WSRF. Construct the various  
  WSRF specifications.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)       Interactive, web-based science, education, and cooperation are made possible by  
  gateways. Discover and illustrate the scientific application gateway component software (3)  
  stack with neat diagram.  
  
  C)       Conclude the Taverna workflow architecture model and explain its working.                   (2)  
4)            Discover the Traditional Features Common to Grids and Clouds  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)       Conclude the Microsoft Azure features                                                       (3)  
  C)       A service level agreement (SLA) is an outsourcing and technology vendor contract that  
  outlines the level of service that a supplier promises to deliver to the customer. Classify (2)  
  the types of service level agreements.  
  
5)            Analyze and explain the different data types and operators supported by pig.                (5)

A)  
  B)          Analyse what is data privacy and outline the measures to ensure the data privacy in  
  cloud computing.                                                                      (3)  
  
  C)          Identify and outline the components of identity and access management.                (2)  
  
-----End-----
